parsed.summary: The proposed patch addresses the issue by checking if the return value is None before attempting to convert it to a unit. This should resolve the AttributeError encountered when using the `units.quantity_input` decorator with constructors that have a return type of None.

issues.description: The patch introduces a minor maintainability/readability defect by adding an explicit check for None, which slightly increases the complexity of the code.
